transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because... my sleep has just gotten really messed up lately. I don't know, I'll either stay up half the night just with my mind running, or... I'll wake up way too early and feel like I never even rested. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you mostly been feeling down or low, or have you actually felt unusually energetic, upbeat, or irritable?

I guess... mostly down. Lately I just wake up with this... heavy feeling. It's kind of empty. Even when I'm just sitting in my condo, which I worked really hard to get... I don't know, it just makes me want to cry. So... yeah, more low than energetic.
How long have you been feeling this low, empty mood — has it been going on for two weeks or more, or has it been a shorter stretch of time?

Um... definitely longer than two weeks. I guess... it's been around five months. Just this... fog. Like this guilty, down feeling that just hangs around. It got a lot worse after I actually bought the condo, but... yeah. Five months, probably.
Aside from feeling low, have you noticed yourself worrying excessively about different things—like work, health, or other everyday matters—more days than not over these past months?

Um... not really, no. I mean, I worry sometimes, like anyone, but... it's not like I'm constantly stressing over work or everyday stuff. It's just... more of that heavy feeling I mentioned. Not really excessive worrying.
Over these past several months, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess so. I... I used to go to this salsa class, but I stopped. And... my paints are just sitting out on the table at home. I look at them and... I don't know, I just feel nothing. It's like they belong to somebody else. So, yeah. I haven't really been doing much.
Has anyone told you that you snore loudly, gasp, or seem to stop breathing while you sleep?
No... nobody's ever said anything like that to me.
Over these past several months, have you been feeling unusually tired or low in energy nearly every day, even when you get some rest?

Yeah... I am. Um, even after a full night in bed, it doesn't really help. Just... walking from the parking lot into the office, it feels like I'm dragging sandbags. And... by lunch, my brain just feels worn out. So... yeah.
You mentioned feeling guilty earlier—can you tell me more about that? Do you often feel worthless or excessively guilty about things, even when they aren't really your fault?

I don't know... I guess I just keep thinking about the mortgage. I keep telling myself I was stupid to take it on. It just feels like I've... let everyone down. Even though, I mean, no bill is actually late. I haven't missed anything. But... yeah. I just feel bad.
